# Build Wiser Construction

> Multi-family remodeling, renovation and restoration contractor serving apartment
> communities and property managers across Greater Kansas City and a 200-mile
> Midwest radius. Over 60 years of combined experience.

## Contact
- Phone: 816-554-8899
- Email: info@buildwiserkc.com
- Office: 1536 Erie Street, North Kansas City, MO 64116
- Website: https://buildwiserkc.com/

## Services
- Multi-family remodeling — unit turns, interior renovations, capital improvement projects, scheduled around occupancy
- Water and flood damage restoration — extraction, drying and full rebuild
- Fire and smoke restoration — board-up, soot and odor removal, structural repair, reconstruction
- Mold remediation — containment, removal, and correction of the moisture source
- Storm and roofing — wind and hail response including roofing, siding, gutters, concrete
- General contracting — plumbing, HVAC, electrical, drywall and concrete under one contract

## Who they serve
Apartment owners, property managers, and HOA boards in the Kansas City metro who
need occupied-property work handled cleanly and units returned to service quickly.

## Differentiators
- Dedicated job supervisor on every project
- 2-3 hour typical emergency response
- Crews trained for occupied multi-family work
- Insurance claim coordination from first walkthrough through final punch

## Hours & response
- Project consultations and estimates by appointment
- 24/7 emergency response for water, fire and storm damage across the Kansas City metro

## Credentials
- A+ rated Better Business Bureau Accredited Business
- Minority-owned, Kansas City–based licensed general contractor
